payload.question: The out-of-date plumb line now compares the plumb Claude Code runs with the version on main in plumb's own online repository (github.com/Cols77/plumb), whatever project or install route. On a mismatch it shows both versions in red and says to update plumb; when the repository can't be read it says 'could not check', not in red. The written requirement still says: compare with the build committed on main, show when it was built, and say 'reload plugins'. Which should hold?
